lines.text: Many learners say: I always am late.
Put always after am, is, or are.
Is always! I am always late.

data.why: Put always after am, is, or are.

native.tip: be動詞のときは、always は be動詞の後ろに置きます。
native.caption: “I always am late.”と言っていませんか？😅 「いつも遅れる」と日本語の順に always を前に置きがちです。“I am always late.” が自然な言い方です。Carlosの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“is always”。同じ形で自分の文を1つ書いてみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: With am, is, are, put always after it.
en.caption: Do you say this? “I always am late.” 😅 Put always after am, is, or are. The natural way is “I am always late.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
